note: SWE-bench style. Check out the fix commit (tests in post-fix state), revert ONLY the non-test source files to the parent. The agent must re-implement the fix. The repo's own tests are the oracle.

tasks.symptom: When a model emits a tool call whose JSON string argument contains a '}' or '{' character, the parser ends the tool call at the wrong place and the call is truncated or rejected. Brace characters inside JSON string literals must not be treated as structural.
tasks.title: ignore braces inside JSON strings when detecting tool call end

tasks.symptom: The llama-server SSE response stream sometimes contains comment/ping lines. These are being parsed as if they were data events, causing errors or bogus output. Comment lines in an SSE stream should be ignored.
tasks.title: ignore llama-server SSE ping comments

tasks.symptom: Multimodal projectors are not being offloaded to the GPU when they should be; GPU offload is incorrectly disallowed for projector layers.
tasks.title: allow GPU offload for projectors

tasks.symptom: The Radeon 8060S integrated GPU is being filtered out during device discovery. It should be allowed by default.
tasks.title: allow Radeon 8060S iGPU by default

tasks.symptom: When a prompt has been shifted, the space reserved for generation is computed incorrectly, leaving too little headroom for the response.
tasks.title: preserve generation headroom for shifted prompts

tasks.symptom: GGUF files that are multimodal projectors (mmproj) are not being classified as projector layers, so their layer accounting is wrong.
tasks.title: classify mmproj GGUFs as projector layers

tasks.symptom: Prompt token counts reported from llama-server omit tokens served from the prompt cache, so the reported counts are too low.
tasks.title: include cached prompt tokens in llama-server counts

tasks.symptom: When llama-server stalls during model load, the stall is not detected from its output and the caller waits indefinitely instead of surfacing an error.
tasks.title: detect llama-server load stalls from output

tasks.symptom: 'ollama ps' reports inflated memory for a partially offloaded model: memory-mapped weights are counted twice.
tasks.title: fix ollama ps double-counting mmap'd weights on partial offload
